correctness.rationale: PASS: Dirichlet gamma-ratio mixed moments differentiated at exponent one yield E(H), while normalized tilt E[P_j²F(P)]=alpha_j(alpha_j+1)/[A(A+1)] E_{alpha+2e_j}F gives E(HQ). Digamma recurrence psi(z+1)-psi(z)=1/z simplifies the covariance to the claimed positive pair-mass term and A times weighted Cov_w(alpha,psi(alpha+1)). The latter equals a sum over i<j of w_i w_j (alpha_i-alpha_j)(psi(alpha_i+1)-psi(alpha_j+1)), nonnegative by strict increasing digamma and zero only for equal parameters. kappa>0 forces strict negative covariance. Independently derived E(HQ) by differentiation of mixed gamma moments (not the quadratic-tilting implementation) and compared exact fractions for all 336 integer vectors alpha_i in {1,2,3,4}, m=2,3,4. Witnesses (1,1):-1/36, (1,3):-37/1200, (2,2):-1/75 agree. The analytical moment argument proves arbitrary real parameters.

value.rationale: PASS: Shannon entropy and Simpson concentration are two canonical ecological/Bayesian probability-diversity observables, and dependence under unequal finite Dirichlet priors is not determined by their individual means/variances. The all-asymmetric exact covariance formula reveals universal negative dependence despite heterogeneity, a quantitative baseline pair-mass lower bound and a sharp symmetry equality condition. This is an independently useful joint-moment fact; not merely a generic sign check or a claim of fixed-total global optimization.

final_claim: For every finite Dirichlet(alpha_1,...,alpha_m) with m>=2 and all alpha_i>0, Shannon entropy H=-sum_i P_i log P_i and concentration Q=sum_i P_i² have Cov(H,Q)=-2/[A(A+1)(A+2)]{kappa/(A+1)+A Cov_w(alpha_i,psi(alpha_i+1))}<0. In particular -Cov(H,Q)>=2kappa/[A(A+1)^2(A+2)] with equality iff all alpha_i are equal.
limitations: Finite m>=2, alpha_i positive real; population random frequencies, not sample plug-in entropy or arbitrary priors.
Quantitative equality at symmetric alpha concerns the stated bound, not a global fixed-total extremum.
Possible exact mixed entropy/power-sum covariance formulas hidden under Tsallis or ecological homozygosity notation remain the priority risk.
